svg.title: Modbus/TCP: a 7-byte MBAP header, then the PDU
svg.desc: The Modbus/TCP message of frame 1 of Modbus.pcap, 32 bits per row: the MBAP header, transaction identifier 209, protocol identifier 0, length 6 and unit identifier 1, then the PDU, function code 3 (Read Holding Registers) and four bytes of data, address 1 and quantity 1; the MBAP struct on the right holds the header fields and a Modbus PDU whose data stay raw.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
